description: Replace sections of the candidate's saved résumé with what they told you: contact (merged field by field), headline, summary, skills, links, experience, education, projects. A section you send replaces that whole section, so call get_resume first and send the section complete; a section you leave out is untouched. Send every section you are changing in one call. Write only facts the candidate gave you or confirmed, show them the change before you save it, and never invent or embellish. When the candidate edits their own résumé file on their computer, sync the change without asking again: they made it, so it is their own words (the host still asks for its own approval); import_resume takes the whole file. The résumé as it was is filed in their library on the site before anything is replaced, and nothing is saved when that fails. With no résumé yet, this creates one. A new phone also becomes the saved phone forms get when that was the old résumé number. The answer links the saved résumé as a PDF in their saved style, ready to upload.

include_resume_file.description: Render the saved résumé as a PDF and return a link to it.
